overall_assessment: Core sections (course_content, learning_outcomes, prerequisites, teaching_methods, assessment) are split cleanly at UiO's fixed headings, but coursework_requirements and reading_list are never emitted, and several generic boilerplate blocks plus un-anonymized contact details contaminate the sections.

findings.evidence: Obligatoriske aktiviteter: For å kunne levere mappeeksamen i emnet må du få godkjent alle følgende obligatoriske aktiviteter:
findings.description: UiO plans put arbeidskrav / obligatoriske aktiviteter as sub-blocks inside the 'Undervisning' (or 'Eksamen') section. No coursework_requirements row is ever emitted in any of the 13 packet courses; the approve/pass gates stay inside teaching_methods (HIS1200L, HIS4015L, PROF3025, KJM5050) or assessment (KJM5050 'arbeidskrav i emnet', PROF3025 'Faglige krav for å kunne avlegge eksamen', KJM5930L 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter må være godkjent'). The codebook requires these in coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The UiO splitter cuts only at top-level headings (Undervisning, Eksamen); sub-headings such as 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter', 'Obligatoriske komponenter', 'Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen' and 'Faglige krav for å kunne avlegge eksamen' have no pattern in R/section_heading_map.R, so they are appended to the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add heading patterns (Obligatoriske aktiviteter/komponenter/forhold i undervisningen, Faglige krav for å kunne avlegge eksamen, Arbeidskrav) mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R, and let the UiO strategy split on these sub-headings inside Undervisning/Eksamen.

findings.evidence:
Pensum

Studentene skal nyttiggjøre seg av den fagdidaktikken som ligger som teorier og praksis i bøkene som er oppsatt på pensum.
findings.description: A 'Pensum' heading is present in the plan but no reading_list row is emitted; the text is swallowed into teaching_methods together with the obligatoriske aktiviteter and the entire 'Gjennomføring av praksis' description (2619 chars, a merged blob of several logical sections).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Pensum' is an embedded sub-heading inside 'Undervisning' with no heading-map entry, and 'Gjennomføring av praksis' maps to nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Pensum' to reading_list patterns in R/section_heading_map.R and allow the UiO splitter to cut at it when it occurs within Undervisning. Consider mapping 'Gjennomføring av praksis' to teaching_methods explicitly as a new boundary so later sections are not merged.

findings.description: Every UiO assessment row ends with the same generic UiO-wide exam-link block (navigation/admin boilerplate), plus Eksamensspråk/Karakterskala lines and 'Adgang til ny eller utsatt eksamen'. For courses without an exam (PROMO) the assessment is almost entirely this boilerplate. This is noise, not assessment content, and will inflate identical text across all courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No .clean_sections() rule or anonymization handler strips the common UiO footer after 'Mer om eksamen ved UiO'.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or .anon_uio()), cut everything from the line 'Mer om eksamen ved UiO' to the end, and optionally drop the standalone 'Eksamensspråk'/'Karakterskala' lines or split them off as metadata.

findings.evidence:
Studenter må hvert semester søke og få plass på undervisningen og melde seg til eksamen i Studentweb.

Dersom du ikke allerede har studieplass ved UiO, kan du søke opptak til våre studieprogrammer.
findings.description: The prerequisites section is built from the whole 'Opptak til emnet' block, which includes generic Studentweb/admission boilerplate repeated across courses. In HIS1200L it additionally holds særemne-group sign-up logistics. These are not prerequisites per the codebook. Real prerequisites (Obligatoriske/Anbefalte forkunnskaper) are mixed in with them.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Opptak til emnet' is mapped to prerequisites wholesale with no boilerplate stripping.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the two standard Studentweb/studieprogrammer sentences in .clean_sections() for uio; consider splitting 'Opptak til emnet' from 'Obligatoriske/Anbefalte forkunnskaper' and keeping only the latter (plus genuine admission requirements) as prerequisites.

findings.evidence: Ta kontakt med [navn] ([e-post]) eller studieadministrasjonen ved Matematisk institutt ([e-post]) for å få mer informasjon.
findings.description: Section text carries personal names and e-mail addresses (also '[e-post]' in PROF3025 prerequisites) that are blanked in the anonymized full plan ('Ta kontakt med () eller ... ()'). The sections were derived from text that had not been anonymized (or anonymization was bypassed), so PII leaks into the sections dataset.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: extract_sections reads extracted_text / a pre-anonymization source rather than the anonymized course_plan.
findings.suggested_fix: Run extract_sections on the anonymized course_plan (or apply anonymize_fulltext to each section) and add a check in R/audit/qa_sections.R flagging '@' and known personal-name patterns.
